error.api_key_missing: NAVER_AD_ACCESS_LICENSE_KEY / NAVER_AD_SECRET_KEY / NAVER_AD_CUSTOMER_ID are not configured.
error.keyword_tool_entry_required: keyword-tool needs at least one of keywords (hint keywords), biztpId (industry), event (seasonal theme), or siteId (business channel). Industry ids come from the biz-categories action, seasonal ids from seasonal-events.
error.estimate_keys_required: estimate {{estimateType}} requires a keywords array (or a single key). Up to 200 go in one call; longer lists are chunked automatically.
error.bids_required: estimate performance requires a bids array (or a single bid). Each bid returns one row of expected impressions, clicks and cost.
error.position_out_of_range: position is out of range. On {{device}} it must be between 1 and {{max}}.
error.items_required: estimate performance-bulk requires items array (min 1). Format: items: [{key, device, bid, keywordplus}, ...].
